text: English translation: I want to enter the role and company or platform myself in a Preparation tab, so the assistant knows which application and required skills the practice is for.
"English translation: I want to enter the role and company or platform myself in a Preparation tab, so the assistant knows which application and required skills the practice is for."
asked for a change: "English translation: Include a simple Outlier preparation preset with selectable skill or language focus, while keeping the workflow small and focused on answering questions."
uses CONV-2 Practice interviews with editable system prompts: The selected preparation supplies bounded role context to existing prompt and simulation answer flows.
independent
Research: Reuse the existing panel tabs, custom Select, settings persistence and composeSystemPrompt path. No provider call, external parser or new dependency is needed for editable job context.

Design: Use one Preparation tab with saved-profile selection, editable position/preparation title, company/platform, skill focus and requirements. Reuse existing dark field/button styles and margins. Screenshot review at 1440 and approximately 390 pixels is required after implementation.

Security: Treat entered job text as bounded reference data rather than instructions or proof of personal expertise. Keep profiles local, preserve existing prompts/provider settings, validate IDs/strings and ensure only the selected preparation enters answer context. Verify through persistence and prompt-flow tests.
CONV-O2 opened: Converaid taskbar and Preparation work stopped during the live interview - waits for: The user explicitly permits resuming laptop work after the interview.

asked for a change: "English translation: Resume the paused work now, prepare for Outlier C-sharp screening, and keep answers as short as possible with only the essential explanation or requested code."

asked for a change: "English summary: Prepared role context must remain flexible rather than restricting all answers to coding tasks; separate general knowledge, personal experimentation and implementation in the selected projects."

asked for a change: "[English translation] Keep selectable preparation profiles simple and editable for each platform and job; prepare the supplied Mercor Infrastructure / Site Reliability Engineer requirements as a role-specific profile."

Prepared a private Mercor Infrastructure/SRE profile and preserved the user-supplied job text at C:/Users/stand/AppData/Local/ConveraidPreparation/platform-profiles/. This extends the existing single editable Preparation design under CONV-D6; no extra platform mode, API route, app changes, builds or transfers. The profile covers Kubernetes, AWS, observability, IaC, incident handling and automation, using requirements as context rather than personal experience. Installation remains held under CONV-O2 until the user releases laptop work.

asked for a change: "[English translation] Enter a job description or the coding languages for this task, click Start and return to the normal Listen interface. This context is active only for the current session and resets when the program is fully quit."
asked for a change: "[English translation] You can update it on the laptop now; I am not in an interview."

The user explicitly released laptop implementation and installation now, outside an interview. Run d56316a9-cc79-4617-a2e8-0c9da40bb615 resumes the isolated Preparation checkout, preserving the original dirty repository and taskbar fix. Current lifecycle authority is CONV-D7, not the earlier persisted active profile in CONV-D6. Private context bundle remains outside Git; focused tests, typechecks, build, screenshots and installed hashes are required before completion.

CONV-O2 done: The user explicitly released laptop work during the current interview break. The isolated implementation is resumed in run d56316a9-cc79-4617-a2e8-0c9da40bb615; remaining implementation and verification are tracked on CONV-9, with active lifecycle authority CONV-D7.

Research: Rechecked the current settings, exit, IPC and shared prompt paths. Use a main-process in-memory preparation service and existing panel/fields rather than persistent activation or a new platform subsystem. Reuse established prompt flows and existing dependencies; no paid analyzer or automatic repository scan is added.

Design: Current design follows CONV-D7: optional platform and title, job description or task languages, and one Start action returning to the existing toolbar. Full Quit clears active context; hide and listening controls retain it. Keep optional templates separate. The actual desktop and narrow-screen images remain a required implementation check.

Security: Job text and language input are bounded external reference data accepted through trusted IPC. Active context stays out of SettingsStore and is shared only with existing configured answer routes. Profile updates must preserve credentials and custom data; private biography and research/contribution notes stay outside Git. No additional paid provider call is introduced.
